attchmntText: Valecha Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about Intimation under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015
voiceSummary: Valecha Engineering Limited received an order from the Commissioner of Income Tax Appeals on 14th October 2026 regarding Assessment Year 2024-25. The order sets aside an alleged income tax demand of Rs. 191.23 Crores. Consequently, the Joint Assistant Commissioner squared off the demand on 14th October 2026. The company states that no further action is required as the matter has become infructuous. There are no expected financial implications, penalties, or restrictions imposed on the company. The communication applies to the financial year 2023-24. The details were disclosed in Form A under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The intimation was filed with BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited.

attchmntText: Valecha Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of Unaudited Financial Results for quarter and half year ended 30.09.2026
voiceSummary: Valecha Engineering Limited published extracts of its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026 in the News Hub English and Marathi dailies on 22 November 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on 20 November 2026 following a limited review by statutory auditors. For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, standalone income from operations was 2.87 crore rupees with a net profit of 1.18 crore rupees. Consolidated income from operations was 8.20 crore rupees with a net loss of 51.50 crore rupees. For the half year ended 30 September 2026, standalone income from operations was 5.67 crore rupees with a net profit of 1.32 crore rupees. Consolidated income from operations was 10.14 crore rupees with a net loss of 37.29 crore rupees. The company also issued a public notice regarding the transfer of a flat in Gharkul S.R.A. Co-operative Housing Society Ltd. to a legal heir.

attchmntText: Unaudited  Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half-year ended 30.09.2026
voiceSummary: Valecha Engineering Limited reported unaudited standalone financial results for the half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board approved these results on 20th November 2026. Revenue from operations was 2.87 Crores for the quarter and 5.67 Crores for the half year. Profit before tax stood at 1.18 Crores for the quarter and 1.36 Crores for the half year. Net profit was 1.18 Crores for the quarter and 1.36 Crores for the half year. Earnings per share were 0.52 for the quarter and 0.60 for the half year. Total assets were 544.52 Crores as at 30th September 2026. The company continues to carry its investment of 39.84 Crores and loans of 76.36 Crores in subsidiary Valecha Kachchh Toll Roads Limited at book value. The resolution plan for the subsidiary is pending NCLT adjudication. No impairment has been recognized on these balances.

attchmntText: Valecha Engineering Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Valecha Engineering Limited reported unaudited standalone financial results for the half year ended 30th September 2026. Revenue from operations was Rs. 5.67 Crores, compared to Rs. 16.30 Crores in the previous year. Total income stood at Rs. 7.18 Crores. Profit before tax was Rs. 1.36 Crores, down from Rs. 10.94 Crores in the corresponding period last year. Net profit for the half year was Rs. 1.36 Crores, with basic earnings per share at Rs. 0.60. Total assets were Rs. 544.52 Crores. The company continues to carry its investment of Rs. 39.84 Crores and loans of Rs. 76.36 Crores in subsidiary Valecha Kachchh Toll Roads Limited at book value, pending the outcome of the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process. No impairment has been recognized on these balances. The Board approved the results on 20th November 2026.
